Mosquito parameters for an OpenMalaria scenario

Source: R/xml_export.R
get_OM_ento_snippet.Rd

Builds the mosquito (entomology) parameters of an OpenMalaria scenario (schema 44) from the bionomics in vec_ent_param, as the input lists of openMalariaUtilities::defineEntomology().

With activity, each taxon is split into three mosquito populations according to human exposure (calculate_exposure): with in_bed the share of bites indoors while in bed (reached by ITNs) and irs the share reached by IRS, chosen with irs_exposure: the proportion resting indoors ("indoor_resting", the endophily; default) or the share of bites indoors ("indoor_biting", Exposure_Indoor_total),

  • <taxon>_indoor1: share min(in_bed, irs), reached by both ITNs and IRS;

  • <taxon>_indoor2: share max(in_bed, irs) - min(in_bed, irs), reached by ITNs only (if in_bed > irs) or by IRS only;

  • <taxon>_outdoor: the rest, reached by neither.

With "indoor_resting", the overlap between biting in bed and resting indoors is an assumption (the largest possible, min()). With "indoor_biting", bites in bed are a part of bites indoors, so indoor1 is exactly the in-bed share and indoor2 the indoor bites outside bed. The vectorial capacity calculation has the same choice through its exposure argument (see calculate_exposure). The populations share all parameters except the human blood index: indoor populations use the indoor HBI, the outdoor population the outdoor HBI. Populations with a share of 0 (e.g. indoor2 when the two shares are equal, or a species with a species_shares of 0) are not written, with a message. Without activity, each taxon is a single population whose human blood index is chosen with hbi.

Mapping to OpenMalaria: mosqRestDuration = resting duration tau in whole days (at least 1), mosqSeekingDuration = td, extrinsicIncubationPeriod = ts, mosqLaidEggsSameDayProportion = A0, mosqSurvivalFeedingCycleProbability = M (parous rate), human host probabilities from hosts_p. Each population also carries a nonHumanHosts entry with the animal host probabilities of hosts_p, written by define_OM_entomology and get_OM_xml (defineEntomology() alone writes fixed animal values and ignores this entry).

Usage

get_OM_ento_snippet(
  taxa,
  level = "species",
  activity = NULL,
  hbi = "weighted",
  hosts_p = def_host_params(),
  propInfected = 0.078,
  propInfectious = 0.021,
  bionomics_table = NULL,
  species_shares = NULL,
  irs_exposure = c("indoor_resting", "indoor_biting")
)

Arguments

taxa

Character vector of taxon names (see list_all_species); the usual synonyms of An. gambiae ss/coluzzii are accepted with a warning.

level

Taxonomic level(s) of taxa: "species" (default), "complex" or "genus"; recycled.

activity

Optional activity patterns (from def_activity_patterns), one per taxon (a single pattern is used for all taxa). Triggers the indoor/outdoor split.

hbi

Human blood index of unsplit populations: "weighted" (default, indoor and outdoor HBI weighted by endophagy), "indoor" or "outdoor".

hosts_p

Host parameters from def_host_params.

propInfected, propInfectious

Initial proportions of infected and infectious mosquitoes, written to seasonalityParameters.

bionomics_table

Optional bionomics table used instead of vec_ent_param (see read_bionomics_table).

species_shares

Optional named vector: share of each taxon in the EIR, one per taxon (names as in taxa, canonical names or synonyms), summing to 1; see eir_shares to compute it from relative abundances and sporozoite rates.

The annualEIR of each population is its relative contribution to the EIR: share of its species \(\times\) share within the species, summing to 1 over all populations. With species_shares, these are numbers; without (default), placeholders "@contrib_<population>@" (the population name with each run of characters other than letters and digits replaced by _, e.g. @contrib_Anopheles_gambiae_ss_coluzzii_indoor1@), whose values for any species composition are given by om_ento_values. In both cases, the total EIR is set with the scaledAnnualEIR attribute of <entomology> (a number or a placeholder, e.g. defineEntomology(..., scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@")).

irs_exposure

With activity: the mosquitoes reached by IRS, "indoor_resting" (default: those resting indoors, the endophily) or "indoor_biting" (those biting indoors, Exposure_Indoor_total). It sets the split and the indoor_resting flag of shares, used by the IRS export.

Value

List with

  • mosquitoParameters: named list (one element per mosquito population) for defineEntomology(mosquitoParameters = );

  • seasonalityParameters: named list skeleton for defineEntomology(seasonalityParameters = ), with placeholders "@contrib_<population>@" for annualEIR (numbers with species_shares) and "@m1@", ..., "@m12@" for the seasonality, filled per scenario (columns m1, ..., m12), or replaced by numbers with define_OM_entomology(seasonality = ) (older openMalariaUtilities versions reject the placeholders with R >= 4.3);

  • shares: data frame with mosquito, taxon, type (indoor1, indoor2, outdoor or all), share within the taxon (with species_shares, also species_share and the overall eir_share), and the logical columns in_bed and indoor_resting (reached by interventions acting in bed, e.g. ITNs, or by IRS: resting indoors, or biting indoors with irs_exposure = "indoor_biting"), and muvA, the host-seeking death rate without interventions (per day, with the population's HBI);

  • model_params: named list (one element per mosquito population) of build_model_obj outputs with the population's HBI (NULL if the bionomics give no valid death rate); their human availability scales the dummy hosts of host-seeking killing (define_OM_vector_control);

  • irs_exposure: the choice above (NULL without activity).

See also

get_OM_GVI_snippet, define_OM_vector_control

Examples

om = get_OM_ento_snippet("Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii",
                         activity = def_activity_patterns())
#> get_OM_ento_snippet: annualEIR = a placeholder @contrib_<population>@ for the relative contribution of each population (values: om_ento_values()); set the total EIR with scaledAnnualEIR (e.g. defineEntomology(..., scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@")).
names(om$mosquitoParameters)
#> [1] "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_indoor1"
#> [2] "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_indoor2"
#> [3] "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_outdoor"
om$shares
#>                                mosquito                         taxon    type
#> 1 Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_indoor1 Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii indoor1
#> 2 Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_indoor2 Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii indoor2
#> 3 Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii_outdoor Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii outdoor
#>        share in_bed indoor_resting      muvA
#> 1 0.72582440   TRUE           TRUE 0.6461614
#> 2 0.19806053   TRUE          FALSE 0.6461614
#> 3 0.07611507  FALSE          FALSE 0.6461614
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
baseList = openMalariaUtilities::defineEntomology(
    baseList, om$seasonalityParameters, om$mosquitoParameters)
} # }
